about: A bot whose AI is signed out (run with FAKE_CLAUDE_MODE=not-logged-in): the sidebar row carries the server's sign-in notice, naming the settings pane to go to. The row's preview is set to wrap (CSS only) so the whole sentence shows; its words are the server's own.

steps.eval: for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label="Bots and navigation"] *')) { if (el.children.length === 0 && el.textContent.includes('Sign in again in Settings')) { let node = el; for (let i = 0; i < 6 && node; i++, node = node.parentElement) { node.style.whiteSpace = 'normal'; node.style.overflow = 'visible'; node.style.textOverflow = 'clip'; node.style.webkitLineClamp = 'unset'; node.style.height = 'auto'; node.style.maxHeight = 'none'; node.style.minHeight = '0'; } } }
